Align Java and Objective-C EMAPI remaining parity boundaries.

Align Java and Objective-C EMAPI remaining parity boundaries.

Details:
- Add a Java ConnectedDevice EMAPI connection adapter and public builder/static convenience entrypoints.
- Reject invalid fallbackMtu, mtu, and maxRetries instead of silently clamping in Java and Objective-C.
- Preserve a device-returned MTU tag value of 0 in Java and reject later transfer use while keeping fallback behavior for absent MTU tags.
- Compare Java matcher helper arguments directly so out-of-range values no longer match by byte masking.
- Add Java and Objective-C regression coverage for the parity gaps.

Validation:
- mvn -pl fruits/emapi test -DskipTests=false passed after installing local frame/adapter prerequisites into the lane Maven cache.
- mvn -pl fruits/emapi -am test -DskipTests=false passed: 53 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors.
- just java passed across the Java reactor.
- git diff --check passed.
- xcodebuild is unavailable on this Linux lane; Objective-C XCTest remains to run on macOS with xcodebuild -project objectivec/fruits/emapi/emapi.xcodeproj -scheme emapi test.
